findings.finding: Skill identity arguments are not asserted by the new skill payload test.
findings.evidence: Only this new SourceTools test invokes CreateSkillCorpusResourcePayload; canonical contractId, schemaVersion and protocol rows plus independent identity/fingerprint variations are absent. Add direct assertions for the existing negotiated identity contract.

findings.finding: Renderer test omits independent fingerprint sensitivity.
findings.evidence: Existing RendererPayload_BoundsContributeToFingerprint changes both limits together, so loss of either individual bound can pass; the new case checks text only and strategy has no paired fingerprint assertion. Extend the new case with independent strategy and bound variations.

findings.finding: New diagnostic equality case admits reference-only equality.
findings.evidence: Its same-instance and null assertions do not establish independently created diagnostic value equality or sensitivity to every identity field used by generic caches. Existing round-trip cache cases do not replace these new direct public comparison boundaries; assert equal-copy hashes and changed-field inequality without numeric hash pins.

findings.finding: First-enum fixture does not distinguish declaration and name order.
findings.evidence: The first property is A and second Z, so alphabetical sorting preserves the same answer despite the parser documented declaration-order fallback. Reverse property names and add the corresponding unknown-state refusal using the selected enum.

findings.finding: Malformed annotation cases leave fallback metadata unchecked.
findings.evidence: The test only requires Value to survive, admitting fabricated CTA/group/priority/format metadata. RelativeTime(null) currently uses int and can stop at the earlier incompatible-type branch. Assert existing fallback metadata, and use DateTime to reach invalid-window handling with its warning/default-format contract.
